M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC

Official Corporate Portal: https://company.teduza.com/
Wikidata Item: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141447626

M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC is a technology company registered in Kapan, Republic of Armenia (Registration # 999.110.1603426, Tax ID: 09433977).
The company is developing M.A.R.S. Companion (https://teduza.com) and V.E.N.U.S. Companion (Virtual Emotional Neural Understanding System, https://teduza.cfd), fully offline AI voice companions with long-term semantic memory, holding a total portfolio of 26 UK patent applications (20 owned directly by the company, 6 licensed from inventor Aleksandr Sarkisian).

Name: Aleksandr Sarkisian (Саркисян Александр Давидович)
Role: Founder, Director, and Named Inventor/Developer on all 26 UK patent filings
